_comment: Fictional persona for SOH-221 stress data. No real people.
name: Owen Fitzgerald
about_me: I'm Owen, a Ross MBA and VP of the Michigan Venture Club. Before school I was a mechanical engineer at an automotive supplier. I want a full-time VC associate role after graduation, ideally at a Midwest climate or mobility fund.
goals: Get a full-time VC associate offer at a Midwest fund

debriefs.text: Grace Adeyemi, our club president, is running the Chicago VC trek in February. She's lining up Lakeshore Capital and wants a climate fund on the list.

Met Priya Rao at the Northwind Climate Fund office hours. She's a partner there, backs climate hardware at seed, and said they might add an associate next fall. She wants to see a sourcing memo from me.
Coffee with Victor Stahl, partner at Lakeshore Capital in Chicago. They do growth-stage consumer and fintech and said they're not hiring associates this year.
Talked to Olivia Grant, talent partner at Huron Ventures. She helps portfolio companies hire and knows which Midwest funds are adding associates. She offered to review my resume.
Met Wes Bradley at A2 Launchpad office hours. He's an angel and former HR-tech founder who holds Friday office hours. He said he'd introduce me to two fund GPs.

card.headline: Ross MBA, VP Michigan Venture Club
card.about: Engineer turned investor, focused on climate and mobility.
